name: sol-advisor-work
description: Quality-first ChatGPT Work orchestration led by GPT-5.6 Sol with capability-aware delegation and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Sol-led orchestration that adapts to the Work capabilities available at runtime.
interface.longDescription: A ChatGPT Work-native adaptation of Sol Advisor. Sol owns intent, architecture, verification, and acceptance. Exact worker routing is used only when the Work runtime exposes the required controls; otherwise the workflow uses available Work parallelism or a Sol-led fallback. Shared-state writes are serialized and review is risk-gated.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestration. Run the WORK CAPABILITY CHECK first and keep Sol as the quality control plane.
Use only delegation capabilities the current Work runtime exposes and verify observable results before acceptance.
